ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Period__c, "Custom Minutes"), OR(Custom_Length__c < 5, Custom_Length__c > 180)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Period__c, "Custom Hours"), OR(Custom_Length__c < 1, Custom_Length__c > 168)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Period__c, "Custom Days"), OR(Custom_Length__c < 1, Custom_Length__c > 31)), AND(BEGINS(TEXT(Period__c), "Custom"), ISBLANK(Custom_Length__c)))
